Vendor / namely hris cost

Namely pricing in 2026

Namely is quote-only with a 50-seat practical minimum. Buying-committee bands put PEPM at $12-$30 for 100-500 employees. Managed Payroll is a separate line item. Implementation runs $2,500-$12,000. Culture-focused mid-market story with US-only practical footprint.

What the buying committee actually pays

Culture-focused mid-market HRIS. US-only practical footprint. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

What is the PEPM range at 100-500 employees?

$12-$30 PEPM depending on tier and module count. Core Namely lands around $12-$18; full Talent + Managed Payroll lands $22-$30.

How is Payroll priced?

Two options: self-service Payroll (bundled with the platform PEPM) and Managed Payroll (separate, fully-managed by Namely's payroll ops team, priced per-employee-per-pay-period on top).

What is implementation?

$2,500-$12,000 depending on seat count and module scope. Implementation timeline is 8-14 weeks.

Is there a seat minimum?

50 seats is the floor. Smaller deployments are declined or routed to partners.

When does Namely beat BambooHR or HiBob?

For US-only culture-led mid-market buyers who want a single newsfeed-style social hub. BambooHR wins on TCO; HiBob wins on global culture. Namely sits between them on price.
